quotes.text: The little company of which he had charge consisted of his wife and children, his father, and a few other members of the family. They had three baggage wagons, one family carriage, six yoke of oxen, six cows, four calves, one yearling, and a pair of mules, making in all twenty-five head of animals.
The oxen (ten yoke) and all the mules were gone, and the wagons rifled of much of their contents.
